learningRateNote: Do not multiply leaf values by learning_rate at inference. sklearn applies shrinkage when trees are grown; node.value is already scaled.

inference.eachTree: Walk nodes from index 0. If isLeaf, add node.value and stop. If feature value is NaN, go left if missingGoToLeft else right. Else if value <= numThreshold go left, else right. No categorical splits.
then: If currentSpeed <= 1: do not apply the model; use Model 1 hold.
